# 设置人脸识别基准脸库
##### 简要描述

- **XML**字段解释<span lang="EN-US"></span>

| <span class="colour" style="color:black">字段</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:black">类型</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:black">描述</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:black">是否必须</span> |
| --- | --- | --- | ---- |
| FaceGroupPriority | interger | 基准脸库优先级,取值[0,5];0-表示当前脸库无效,1-5表示当前脸库作为人脸识别对比脸库的优先级,数值越大优先级越高<span lang="EN-US"></span> | 是<span lang="EN-US"></span> |
| FaceGroupID | string | 脸库ID(人脸识别前抓前比功能使用),最大长度64，不可为空，对应创建脸库时的“GroupID2”，唯一性，最大长度64。不可为空 | 是<span lang="EN-US"></span> |

![image.png](data:image/png;base64,)

``` http
PUT /FaceGroup/FaceRecognizeStardandGroupList HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46
Content-Type: application/xml
User-Agent: PostmanRuntime/7.42.0
Accept: */*
Cache-Control: no-cache
Postman-Token: 68a89fac-10f7-47d1-8a17-b373dc5f9414
Host: 192.168.6.150
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
Connection: keep-alive
Content-Length: 270

<?xml version = "1.0" encoding = "utf-8"?>
<FaceRecognizeStardandGroupList>
<StardandGroup>
<FaceGroupPriority>5</FaceGroupPriority>
<FaceGroupID>df64045bf5d849cfbe3fe01df78ac398</FaceGroupID>
</StardandGroup>
</FaceRecognizeStardandGroups>


HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Server: CGI/2.0.5
Content-Type: application/xml
Connection: close
Content-Length: 207

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<ResponseStatus Version="1.0">
<requestURL>/FaceGroup/FaceRecognizeStardandGroupList</requestURL>
<statusCode>0</statusCode>
<message />
</ResponseStatus>
```
